method: Recover released definition; identify fixture; survey acceptance-relevant geometry using independently justified reference and reduction path, without using the disputed generated file as truth
reduces: Assembly dimensional error and correspondence between released geometry and physical reference; calibration-chain bias only to extent the new chain is demonstrably separate
does_not_resolve: Optical performance and processing correctness; auxiliary accuracy; unmeasured geometry; shared design-definition error; environmental or calibration bias that is still common
evidence_required: Released revision and tolerances; critical measurands; fixture serial/configuration; instrument calibration lineage; raw readings; environmental record; uncertainty and covariance; decision rule; independent review
recommendation: Selected next check; retain hold until interpretable result exists
proposed_owner: Proposed metrology lead; fixture configuration custodian

method: Repeat primary acquisition and processing; identify whether setup/operator/environment are held fixed or deliberately varied
reduces: Repeatability and random variation; limited drift or setup variation if actually varied and recorded
does_not_resolve: Systematic error in the shared physical reference; generated geometry error; shared calibration or model bias; no independence merely because a second computer is used
evidence_required: Raw repeated observations; configuration; conditions varied; spread/uncertainty analysis; shared-dependency statement
recommendation: Useful supporting check; not the first discriminator for the missing assembly verification

method: Plan an alternative physical method sensitive to the same acceptance-relevant measurand with separately traceable reference/calibration/data/analysis
reduces: Method-specific systematic error and model dependence of the preferred optical path, where the alternative is sufficiently sensitive and technically distinct
does_not_resolve: Errors in a common released definition or calibration standard; shared environment; inadequate resolution; its own uncharacterized systematic error; assembly errors outside measured scope
evidence_required: Method feasibility and sensitivity; calibration and independence inventory; raw data; uncertainty budget and correlations; common-measurand comparison
recommendation: Next candidate if V01 is dimensionally consistent but the contradiction remains, or V01 cannot address the relevant error with adequate sensitivity
proposed_owner: Proposed metrology lead and auxiliary measurement owner
